items.meta_description: The free, open-source engine of your self-hosted VPN. Runs on Linux, Windows, or Docker, shrugs off probing and blocking, and works with or without VpnHood! MANAGER.
items.page_desc: The engine of your VPN. It runs on your own machine, carries your users' traffic, and answers to nobody's infrastructure but yours.
items.f_anywhere_desc: Linux, Windows, or Docker — any VPS or dedicated machine from any provider, installed with a single pasted command.
items.f_stealth_title: Hard to spot, harder to block
items.f_stealth_desc: With Cloak Mode, the tunnel is shaped to look like ordinary web traffic — and an unauthenticated probe gets a plain web-server response instead of anything worth testing.
items.f_engine_desc: VpnHood! ENGINE keeps the connection encrypted and stable across hostile networks, with IPv4 and IPv6 support.
items.f_open_desc: Every line is public on GitHub, and the project has been audited by independent security firms. Nothing to take on faith.
items.run_manager_desc: The free panel installs the server for you, watches it live, and issues your access keys. The easiest path for most people.
items.run_solo_desc: No panel required: a built-in file-based access manager lets a single server issue its own keys, configured from a simple settings file.
items.setup_guide: Setup guide: install on Windows, Linux, or Docker
items.cta: Free, open-source, and ready for your server.
